In this directory we have the scripts used to retrieve homologs of 27 proteins from Eukarya, Archaea, and Bacteria.
Since we are looking for so many proteins the script has been split into two sets: A and B. The Eukarya runs directly and has no array.
The Archaea script has an array of 12 whereas Bacteria has an array of 61 (with each subset being roughly the same size). 

The pipeline is 5 parts.
Part 1 "Initial search using Pfam HMM and sequencesfor each protein ": perform HMMsearch and MMseq against the respective databases, retrieve fl sequences
    Intermediate step: concatinate all retrieved files for MMseq and HMMsearch into one merged file for all three
Part 2 "Cross domain searches and deep iterative searches for each protein": use the merged file to run a MMseq search against the databases, then with the outputed fl sequences use them as a query for an additional search against itself.
Part 3 "Quality control for each protein" : with the outputted fl sequences as query a HMMscan and HMMalgin are run. With thresholds set only sequences clearing both are deemed homologs. 
Part 4 "compiling into tsv and fasta file for all proteins": Use the output of the QC Part 3 to generate a single .tsv file containing all data per Archaea/Bacteria and Eukary, as well as a database of each protein. 
Part 5 "prep for Diamond blast for each protein": Run Diamond blast database creation to prep for the diamond blast run.
